defect: The fix restructures the work-in-progress join order optimizer header (Relation constructors, vector of relations, subquery Visit, bool ExtractBindings) to support non-inner joins; no defect lies in the declarations this change added.
reason: Header changes in the fix are part of continued feature development of the optimizer, not a repair of a bug in the parent, filter-info or neighbor declarations added here.

defect: ExtractBindings now throws NotImplementedException for any correlated subquery in a filter, and because this commit moves subquery rewriting after join ordering, queries with correlated subqueries (e.g. TPC-H) fail instead of running.
reason: The fix replaces exactly this added throw with a bail-out (bindings.clear, return false) and moves the subquery optimization out of ExtractBindings, after which all of TPC-H works.

defect: The fix replaces a call to the grandparent ExpressionBinder::BindExpression with SelectBinder::BindExpression to satisfy clang-tidy's parent-virtual-call check.
reason: For a column reference SelectBinder::BindExpression only re-checks groups and then calls ExpressionBinder::BindExpression, so behaviour is unchanged; it is a tidy-check fix.

defect: The change only reformats two JoinRelation constructor calls; the fix adds a JoinRefType parameter to Join and CrossProduct.
reason: The fix is an API extension, and the reformatted lines contained no defect.

defect: The change only reformats the constructor initializer list; the fix merges two constructors into one taking a JoinRefType.
reason: This is a formatting change followed by a refactor, with no defect repaired.

defect: The new members low_index, high_index and equal_index are left uninitialized and are only set conditionally by the plan generator, so the index scan reads indeterminate bools (undefined behaviour, wrong scan branch).
reason: The fix initializes exactly these three bools added by this change to false.

defect: VerifyBuffers is added as a pure virtual method of BoundIndex, so extension index types that subclass BoundIndex become abstract and the extension build breaks.
reason: The fix makes VerifyBuffers a non-pure virtual with a default implementation, titled 'fix extension build'; seeing the breakage needs the extension subclasses.

defect: The change only reformats the TableColumnType enum and declarations; the fix gives the enum a fixed uint8_t underlying type for serialization.
reason: The serialization issue with the enum's unspecified size predates this pure formatting change.

defect: The fix makes FilterSelection handle non-flat (compressed, constant or dictionary) vectors via UnifiedVectorFormat, including struct child vectors that the scan does not flatten.
reason: Treating the struct child vector as flat was already present in the STRUCT_EXTRACT case added in 79ffe74 and 1cc8202; this change only switched which validity mask is passed.

defect: The fix reorganizes vector.hpp's includes into unified_vector_format.hpp to remove recursive headers.
reason: Header restructuring months later is a refactor; the mutex include and member added here are not repaired.

defect: The fix corrects the inverted key check (!= EXTRA_INFO instead of ==) in the extra-info profiling test and restructures its cleanup.
reason: The inverted condition predates this change, which only added the found flag and REQUIRE that exposed it, and the fix is a test-only change.

defect: The fix only reformats the bind function signature after the parameter type was changed to named_parameter_map_t.
reason: This is a clang-format change with no behavioural difference.

defect: The fix makes the constant BLOB shortcut skip TRY_CAST so try_cast keeps its semantics.
reason: This change only replaced a using-namespace with qualified names; the missing tryCast check is unrelated to it.

defect: PurgeAgedBlocksInternal returns is_fresh to IterateUnloadableBlocks, which stops when the callback returns false, so iteration continues on fresh blocks and stops at the first aged one (inverted).
reason: The fix changes exactly this added return to !is_fresh, and the inversion is visible because IterateUnloadableBlocks is in the same diff.

defect: The fix switches one HTTPException construction to the templated response constructor.
reason: Both forms pass the same status and body, so this is a refactor, not a repair.

defect: The change only reformats the HTTPException call; the fix switches it to the templated response constructor.
reason: No behaviour changes in either the formatting change or the fix.

defect: This commit makes the scan state hold a shared_ptr to the DatabaseInstance, declared as the last member of ColumnDataScanState, so it is destroyed before the pinned chunk handles, which then unpin against a possibly freed database (use-after-free).
reason: The fix 'fix ci failures' moves db to the first member in the header and reorders this file's assignment accordingly; the defect needs the scan-state header to see.

defect: The fix only adds static to the inline helper functions GetSet and TabulateCharacters.
reason: No other definitions of these names exist, so this is a linkage and style cleanup, not a repair.

defect: The rewritten WriteCopyStatement drops the schema prefix, so EXPORT DATABASE writes COPY statements in load.sql that load tables from non-default schemas into the wrong schema.
reason: The fix restores the schema_name qualification removed here (ExportedTableData.table_name carries no schema) and replaces the fragile index pairing.

defect: PrepareParameters takes the unnamed values by value and returns them by move, and its caller passes std::move(unnamed_values), so the caller's parameter vector is consumed and re-executing a prepared statement sees empty values.
reason: The fix removes the unnamed parameter from PrepareParameters and keeps a reference to the caller's values; the move at the call site is in the .cpp.

defect: The fix stops PendingQuery from consuming the caller's unnamed values via std::move into PrepareParameters.
reason: The std::move(unnamed_values) consumption was already introduced in 7f6411a; this change only altered the named-values parameter type.

defect: The fix regenerates the MetricGroup string table with INVALID last, matching the fixed generator scripts.
reason: Enum string lookup searches by value, so the entry order has no runtime effect; it is generated-code consistency.

defect: TypeHasExactRowCount recurses with kv.second.id(), which converts back to a LogicalType without child info, so nested STRUCT children lose their type info (assertion or crash, wrong row count).
reason: The fix passes kv.second instead of kv.second.id() in exactly the recursive call this change added (issue #4859).

defect: HomeDirectorySetting::SetLocal uses input.IsNull() ? input.ToString() : string(), which is inverted, so setting a home directory stores an empty string.
reason: The fix replaces this added expression with input.ToString(), and the inversion is visible in the diff.

defect: REQUIRE(a && b) with an unparenthesized && is rejected by Catch's expression decomposer (static_assert), so the test file fails to compile.
reason: The fix wraps exactly this added expression in extra parentheses.

defect: The new INT128 case instantiates TemplatedExecute with int128_t, a type not defined in DuckDB (the storage type is hugeint_t), so it fails to compile or compares the wrong type.
reason: The fix 'Whoops, wrong type' replaces int128_t with hugeint_t in this added line.

defect: The fix changes SetConfig to take LogConfig by const reference instead of by value.
reason: This is a clang-tidy performance fix, with no functional defect.

defect: The fix prints file-level filters under a separate 'File Filters:' heading in EXPLAIN and updates the parquet hive tests.
reason: This is iteration on a new EXPLAIN output format together with test expectations, not a repair of wrong results.

defect: The fix removes a leftover debugging variable (break_here) from the work-in-progress column lifetime analyzer.
reason: Removing an unused debug variable is cleanup; the WIP logic changes in this commit are not what the fix repairs.

defect: The fix avoids dereferencing a NULL out_file in duckdb_file_system_open.
reason: The *out_file = nullptr writes on the error paths were added later in 7df0eb3; this change never wrote through out_file before checking it.

defect: The fix replaces the deprecated pybind11 constructor py::object(ele, true) with reinterpret_borrow.
reason: Both forms are semantically identical borrows, so this only silences a deprecation warning.

defect: The fix replaces deprecated py::object(ptr, true) constructions with reinterpret_borrow and py::none().
reason: Behaviour is unchanged (utcoffset is still called with None); it is a deprecation-warning cleanup.

defect: A NULL as the first entry of a segment stores dictionary.end (an absolute position) as its offset instead of 0, which breaks the new offset-difference string length computation for following strings.
reason: The fix changes exactly this added else-branch from dictionary.end to 0, and the inconsistency with non-null entries storing dictionary.size is visible in the diff.

defect: union_null_cols is filled only for the file's schema columns, but ScanInternal indexes it for every result column, including generated filename, file_row_number and hive columns, so it reads out of bounds (segfault).
reason: The fix removes this push_back, sizes union_null_cols to return_types in parquet-extension.cpp and asserts its size covers the result columns.

defect: IsSingleLineStatement classifies skipif and onlyif as single-line statements, so the runner rejects valid test files where these directives are followed by their statement on the next line.
reason: The fix moves SKIP_IF and ONLY_IF to the false branch of exactly this added function.

defect: The new tie detection loads row indices through entry_ptrs after the re-order memcpy has overwritten the memory they point to, so it compares the wrong entries and computes wrong ties (wrong multi-column sort order).
reason: The fix reads the indices sequentially from the re-ordered data (dataptr + start*ENTRY_SIZE) instead of entry_ptrs in exactly these added lines.

defect: The fix additionally refuses to push an OR filter whose column id is INVALID_INDEX.
reason: Pushing filters with an invalid column id was possible before this change, which only narrowed the condition with column_id_set.

defect: The fix stops the build/probe side optimizer from flipping ASOF joins, which changes their asymmetric semantics and adds rows.
reason: VisitOperator already tried to flip LOGICAL_ASOF_JOIN before this change; adding ASOF to FlipChildren only completed the flip, and the fix removes the flipping in both places.

defect: The fix makes function deserialization look up builtins in SYSTEM_CATALOG instead of the search path, so a user macro shadowing a builtin (e.g. sum) is not picked.
reason: At this commit there was a single catalog, so INVALID_CATALOG resolved to the same place as before; the shadowing problem arose only once a separate system catalog existed.

defect: The fix adds an explicit cast to silence the narrowing of int64 val.upper into the uint64 words array.
reason: The same int64-to-uint64 narrowing in the brace initializer existed before this change, and the value is correct after negation.
